question: Where is restaurant situated within 160 kilometers along the travel path toward MVMCC, Novato, CA from Golden Gate Bridge Lookout, Sausalito, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.486003 37.82872)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.523212 38.04376)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.486003 37.82872)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.486003 37.82872)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
